confidence_notes: A July food guide and a local price index support the meal and coffee estimates. Draft-beer data are sparse. Local menus informed cocktail and house wine estimates relative to beer. July lodging prices are model estimates and carry the most uncertainty. [July food guide](https://www.ph-nomad.com/siargao-food-costs-2026-july), [local price index](https://citycost.org/siargao/), [restaurant drinks menu](https://restaurantguru.com/The-Bliss-General-Luna/menu)
comparable_city_reasoning: General Luna, Siargao’s main visitor hub, is the local benchmark. San Juan, La Union is a qualitative lodging comparable because both surf destinations serve backpackers and short-stay beach visitors.
